Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You put your armored shoulder behind your weapon and walk straight into the press of steel.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self.
Duration
Movement is immediate; Stability lasts until your next turn.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires worn armor and a melee weapon; grants neither.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Movement / Defense

Move up to 3 squares without provoking. While wearing armor and holding a melee weapon, gain Stability 3 until the start of your next turn. Movement must follow a legal path and end in a free supported square. This grants no attack.
